name: dobe_drink4
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind keeps its head pressed forward in place, face and eyes hidden, the whole body barely moves: only its head and neck bob very slightly up and down by a couple of pixels like slow steady gulps, its throat gently pulses, thick pink goo keeps overflowing from its mouth and dribbling down in long sticky strands, no white teeth, arm and lower body stay still, very subtle motion, looping
